title: Blood and Glory
description: Varn fought in the Bloodsand Arena and came out of it; not everyone does. He has sent you south to Gormund the Pitmaster, who runs the sand for money.

objectives.description: Find Gormund the Pitmaster at the Bloodsand Arena

notes: Signpost quest; no threat by design per audit. Establishes Gormund's motive (money, not honor) ahead of arena_novice_tournament (arena_tournament.json) and arena_tier_1.
